# Input Field

Enter and edit textual or digital data.
See [Input fields guidelines<i class="mat-icon">launch</i>](https://design-system.airbus.corp/components/input-field/design/)

The `ds-input` CSS class is to be used on `<input>` elements. The following type attributes are supported:

- `type="text"`
- `type="password"`
- `type="email"`
- `type="tel"`

Modifier classes are provided which affect the color (`ds-input--valid`, `ds-input--invalid`) or the size.

<Canvas of={InputStories.Basic} />

## Examples

### Variants

**Error** and **success** variants are designed to provide feedback after form validation.

The **Info** variant can be used to assist users while typing something that could be wrong, reducing the risk of an error after validation.

### Sizes

### Adornments

In order to display an icon within a text input, you have to wrap your input in an element with the `ds-input-group` class. Then you can append one of 2 modifiers on the input:

- `ds-input--adorned-start`
- `ds-input--adorned-end`

You also have to wrap your icon in an element with the `.ds-inputadornment` and one of 2 modifiers:

- `ds-inputadornment--start` if `ds-input--adorned-start` is used on the input
- `ds-inputadornment--end` if `ds-input--adorned-end` is used on the input

<Canvas of={InputStories.Adornments} />

### Password

Using a `ds-formcontrol` and a `ds-input-group` you can an icon button adornment (`ds-inputadornment`) and a link (`ds-helplink`)
